note: The bitcoin mark (646 BTC, +43% in Q3, ~+$0.17/unit against a $0.82-0.85 bar) is a real quantified item the two-to-three analyst bar almost certainly excludes, but it sits below operating income, is stripped out of EBITDA and DCF on a 9% yield MLP, and the baseline shows this line has never driven a reaction; the coal and royalty proxies roughly offset, and seven prints inside +/-4.1% cap the whole name.

The first 2027 guide is the only line this REIT has traded on (Oct-25 guide -4.0%, Aug-26 raise +3.82%), and it has to absorb the FAA Des Plaines vacancy (~186k RSF, est. 2-3% of a $3.10 FFO base), a 3.6%-to-~5.5% Loma Linda refi step and a share price below every acquisition threshold the CEO named; the procurement rent growth and FDLE delivery are a genuine offset and the rent figure rests on a 2020 GSA prospectus, so the size is netted rather than headline.

A three-estimate bar set 4-5% below the last reported quarter while the Q2 drivers documented in the 8-K (loans +$106m, NIM flat, provision $1.7m, $51.9m of securities cash flow) continue, confirmed on the environment by Indiana peers printing 21-22 October after the bar was last refreshed, into 10% of shares short at 11 days to cover on a name that rose +3.1% to +4.2% on each of its last three beats; the watch-list build and First Merchants' $29.4m of in-state charge-offs are a real two-sided credit tail and carry the largest single offset.

The undesignated swap book's direction and per-bp scale are established by the company's own four reported quarters and the 5y rose 90bp in Q3 against a Treasury primary source, so a GAAP headline of roughly $1.55-1.85 on a $1.26 bar (and revenue well above the $38-39m consensus) is close to arithmetic on a newly listed, screener-visible name with four analysts; what holds it down is that the company has itself called the mark non-economic since 2024, a third of it had already given back by 22 October, the unsized AOCI hit from the same move cuts the other way, and the stock sits exactly on the four-analyst $56 target 1.3% off its high with no reaction history at all.
